entities.name: Sursi
entities.description: A large plateau in southern Aerona on Dominaria and a village there, home of mesa pegasi.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker attacked on the Plains of Sursi who sanctified the lands as she died.

entities.name: Brother Angus
entities.description: Took Serra's body and created the Cathedral of Serra.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation that colonized Sursi in the Mending Era.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: Religion for which Sursi was important.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane reached by the portal near Sursi.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Resident of the Koskun Mountains on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event that likely deactivated the portal.

events.summary: On the Plains of Sursi, Serra is attacked by a disguised planeswalker who thought her wedding ring was a powerful artifact.
events.quote: Serra was attacked by another (disguised) planeswalker

events.summary: Dying, Serra sanctifies and revitalizes the lands; Brother Angus creates the Cathedral of Serra.
events.quote: she sanctified and revitalized the lands surrounding Sursi

events.summary: In the Mending Era Benalia colonizes Sursi.
events.quote: Sursi was colonized by Benalia because of its importance to the Church of Serra

relations.quote: Brother Angus took her body and created the Cathedral of Serra
